name: Xiang Tiantian
source:
Soldier of the Central Empire who was mistress of the Emperor Xiu. She was stand out Empire's admiral from the Red Faction. [spoiler]After the invention of Hyperthrombus (super-mega-ultra-very big Central Empire's warship) she was in charge of it. But the Hyperthrombus warship due to Chinese engineers had some malfunctions, so it had proved quite useless.

After she was captured by Japan she became an admiral of Japanese Fleet and was still in charge of Hyperthrombus.[/spoiler]

She thinks that Tougou is a great person and madly loves him.
